name: Polygon.io
label: Polygon.io
description: Polygon.io official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: aggregates, ticker_details, snapshot, news. Docs: https://polygon.io/docs/rest/stocks/aggregates/custom-bars. Polygon/Massive terms. Host remains https://api.polygon.io. Bearer or apiKey query. Paid plans for realtime. Display/redistribution limits. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Polygon.io request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"aggregates"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: aggregates | ticker_details | snapshot | news. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'aggregates'.

schema.label: adjusted
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `adjusted` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: from
schema.description: aggregates: path segment YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2024-01-02). Other ops: omit when unused.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `limit` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: multiplier
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `multiplier` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: ticker
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `ticker` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: timespan
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `timespan` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: to
schema.description: aggregates: path segment YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be before `from`. Other ops: omit when unused.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: aggregates, ticker_details, snapshot, news.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `bearer`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
